caseName: Pennsylvania Railroad v. W. F. Jacoby & Co.
caseNameFull: Pennsylvania Railroad Company v. W. F. Jacoby & Company
summary: On a certificate from and writ of certiorari to the United States Circuit Court of Appeals for the Third Circuit.
attorneys: Mr. Francis I. Gowen, Mr. John G. Johnson and Mr. Frederic D. McKenney for The Pennsylvania Railroad Company., Mr. William A. Glasgow, Jr., for Jacoby & Company.

opinions.text:
Judgment affirmed, with costs, by a divided court and cause remanded to the District Court of the United States for the District of Pennsylvania.

Note: December 20, 1915. Petition for rehearing granted, judgment of November 15 vacated and set aside, and case restored to the docket for re-argument.
